description_en: Calls JoinResourceGroup to add an ECS resource or service to a resource group
description_zh: 调用JoinResourceGroup将一个ECS资源或者服务加入一个资源组
kebab_example: aliyun ecs join-resource-group --resource-type securitygroup --resource-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: JoinResourceGroup

parameters.description_en:
The type of the ECS resource. Valid values:

- instance: instance.
- disk: block storage.
- snapshot: snapshot.
- image: image.
- securitygroup: security group.
- ddh: dedicated host.
- ddhcluster: dedicated host cluster.
- eni: elastic network interface.
- keypair: SSH key pair.
- launchtemplate: launch template.
- command: Cloud Assistant command.
- activation: Cloud Assistant managed instance activation code.
- managedinstance: Cloud Assistant managed instance.

The preceding values are case-sensitive.
